annotations.title: Report a wrong price, variant or shop

description: When an offer on a product page is wrong (the shop's page shows another price, the offer is another variant or product, the link leads to the wrong shop or page, or anything else), file a report: `kind` price | variant | category | shop | other, `product_slug` (the stable product id from find_best_price or search_products), the `offer_id` of the offer (from the card's offers; optional) and a `message` saying what you saw (at most 1000 characters). An optional `email` gets the founder's answer; it is never shown. Every report goes to a queue a person reads; the same report sent twice within a day answers the first id with duplicate true. Public, no key; the anonymous rate limit applies.

email.description: Where the answer goes. Optional, never shown.

ip_hash.description: sha-256 of the reporter's address with a daily salt (the website computes it); the per-visitor limit of five reports a minute counts by it. Never stored.

kind.description: What is wrong: the price, the variant or product, the category the product is filed under, the shop or link, or something else.

message.description: What you saw, e.g. the price on the shop's page and when.

offer_id.description: The offer the report is about (offer_id in the card).

page_url.description: The page the report was made on.

user_agent_hash.description: sha-256 of the reporter's user agent (the website computes it); only for spotting floods.

name: report_issue
